notes.subject: man i pisin long wal
notes.rationale: משתין בקיר 'one who urinates against the wall' — Hebrew idiom for every male; kept literally rather than softened to 'every male'

notes.subject: ועצור ועזוב
notes.rationale: 'shut up and left' — read as 'the confined and the free' (ASV/JPS) or 'slave and free' (BSB); kept the literal pair 'ol i pasim na ol i lusim'

notes.subject: כל
notes.rationale: second 'all' folded into 'olgeta man' before 'man i pisin long wal' to avoid doubling in Tok Pisin

translation: Na olgeta man bilong haus Ahab bai ol i lus olgeta, na mi bai katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong Ahab olgeta man i pisin long wal, ol man ol i pasim na ol man ol i lusim, long Yisrael.

tokens.gloss: na mi bai katim i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong
